mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member( login_id, password, name, email, phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, member_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{memberType}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
